about.title: MailOh — demo
about.p1: This is the real MailOh client running on a fixture mailbox: the same sync engine that will talk to your IMAP servers, bootstrapped from local demo data. Every click lands as an optimistic mutation and is confirmed by the demo adapter — no network, nothing leaves this tab.
about.p2: The Screener holds first-time senders until you decide. One click files a sender to Ohbox, Reads or Receipts — the ✓ half also marks the held mail read — and the decision becomes a rule for future mail. Reads and Receipts share a skim stream where scrolling past an item marks it seen at the waterline. Tags group messages across views without moving them.
about.keys: Keyboard: j/k, ↵, y + o/r/c/n/x in the Screener (⇧ marks read), t, /, c, ⌘K.
